insights.one_liner: Vleuten-based industrial pump maker with about 530 staff, IND recognised sponsor, offering a finance internship that needs no Dutch.

culture.text: About 532 people on LinkedIn, headquartered in Vleuten near Utrecht, mainly in sales, engineering and operations.
Staff often studied mechanical engineering or business at Hanze, Hogeschool Utrecht and Avans, plus Poland's Silesian University of Technology.
Makes pumps for chemicals, food, pharma and water treatment, sold through Verder companies worldwide.

open.text: Verder Liquids B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Its one open job here, a finance internship in Vleuten, does not require Dutch; it drew 109 LinkedIn applicants on average.
